sinopsis.es: El príncipe Egon toca batería de noche y de día busca colarse al reino perdido de Kentz para despertar a la Bella Durmiente. Su padre, el rey, no cree en los cuentos. Una arqueóloga de la UNESCO complica todo.
sinopsis.en: Prince Egon plays drums at night and schemes to cross into the lost kingdom of Kentz to wake Sleeping Beauty by day. His father the king doesn't believe in fairy tales. A UNESCO archaeologist complicates everything.
